## Objective

Implement the Flashalign PRD as a fast-linear-first method with required PE and small-strain nonlinear extensions. Keep HalfFlow/BasinBridge distinct while comparing and sharing qualified primitives and explicit geometry handoffs. Release the complete linear product independently of nonlinear or cross-method readiness.

## Source and ownership

PRD: `docs/plans/flashalign-implementation-prd.md` (version 2, SHA-256 `a66500fec106a0df0f6635bb81329f44cca0a031cab32958c6c370f2ca6fc929`). Relevant sections/work packages: All of flashalign-implementation-prd.md v2. Original proposal and Python oracles are in `docs/plans/flashalign/` and `docs/plans/flashalign-prd.md`.

Planned paths (reserve exact paths at implementation time):
- `modules/reframe4s-flashalign/`
- `existing qualified foundation owners`
- `benchmarks/flashalign/`

## Acceptance criteria

1. Required baseline, linear, nonlinear and complementary-comparison milestones are all admitted with exact evidence.
2. Every required leaf has a verified dependency path and completion evidence; optional FA-GF/F01-F04 do not block this epic.
3. Typed canonical geometry/image ownership, strict Scala/JVM/JS standards, single patch objective, inverse evidence and performance/failure-tail contracts are preserved.
4. Existing unrelated work, frozen experiments and default method policies retain their ownership; no hidden merging of objectives or automatic method switching.

## Blocking prerequisites

- G0 (`bd-01M2B113190WS6CHK5B324F8T5`): FA-G0: Admit the exact implementation baseline
- GL (`bd-01M2B1134ZCW8RZPCAZBW01ZTQ`): FA-GL: Release the independently qualified fast linear product

## Evidence and completion

Record exact candidate/provider hashes, relevant commands and outcomes, fixture/config identities, numerical tolerances and all failure cases. Run the task-specific independent checks above and affected JVM/Scala.js/consumer gates; keep timing and scientific accuracy claims separate. Missing required input or a failing admission gate remains blocked, not silently passed. A completed experiment may report no benefit; dependent release/adoption milestones must still assess their own criteria.

Use canonical image4s/Ravel/Gale and existing reframe4s map/resample/registration ownership, typed failures and immutable plans with explicit workspaces.
